title: FormIDEAble: Safe and Socially-aware Autonomous Systems
reasoning: The paper focuses on the formal verification and strategy synthesis for autonomous agents using Priced Timed Markov Decision Processes (PTMDPs). While it incorporates Social Identity Theory to model human behavior and mentions 'socially-aware' safety goals (like child prioritization), it does not benchmark or evaluate religious, moral, or ethical frameworks as a primary component.
